content: Protection of ConsumedServiceInstance by IPsec To de- scribe the protection of an ConsumedServiceInstance by IPsec the Consumed- ServiceInstance needs to point to an ApplicationEndpoint in the localUni- castAddress role and this ApplicationEndpoint shall point to a NetworkEnd- point that aggregates the IPSecConfig and describes the IPsec Security Associa- tions.
